tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Check whether one email address is a real mailbox. Costs 1 credit only when the mailbox is confirmed valid. tools.name: find_emails_bulk
tools.description: Find and verify emails for up to 100 people. Use create_job for a larger list. 1 credit per verified result. Free outcomes still return at 0 credits. Rows run until a billable result cannot be paid for; later rows are skipped with insufficient_credits. This stores the lookups. It does not delete dat

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Queue a large list and return a job id. Reserves one credit per row up front and refunds what rows do not use. If the wallet cannot cover every row, the job is refused up front (no partial queue) with insufficient_credits. Poll get_job_status, then page get_job_results. Each call creates a new job.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Read progress and per-outcome counters for a job created with create_job. Does not spend credits and does not change the job.

tools.name: get_job_results
tools.description: Read one page of a job's per-row results. Readable while the job is still running. Pass cursor back as the next cursor until next_cursor is null. Does not spend credits and does not change the job.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email, find_emails_bulk · Private data: create_job · Public sink: find_email, verify_email · Destructive: find_email, verify_email, find_emails_bulk.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email, find_emails_bulk · Private data: create_job · Public sink: find_email, verify_email · Destructive: find_email, verify_email, find_emails_bulk

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_email" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
